Q5910.reason: The ban on building is a use restriction enforceable in equity against successors with notice under the common scheme, i.e., an equitable servitude.

Q5623.reason: The broadcast concerned a newsworthy public protest and the commentary was privileged as a matter of public interest.

Q5004.reason: The executory interest to the sister's children violates the Rule Against Perpetuities and is void, leaving the friend with full title.
